We develop the following measures designed to align with the short-form evaluations: (1) Edit consistency, (2) Factual consistency, (3) Internal consistency, (4) Topicality, (5) Naturalness. We also evaluate with ROUGE, BERTScore, perplexity, n‑gram entropy, and an NLI‑based consistency metric.

Our primary contributions consist of (1) a novel dataset as well as a survey and classification instrument for assessing long outputs after model editing ( § 3), and (2) automatic metrics that are well correlated with human raters ( § 5).
